title: unified-rollouts-add-dynamic-probing-for-canary-shadow-ab-autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Add dynamic probing and stability guards to unified rollouts.

Motivation: improve automatic rollback behavior for canary/A-B and shadow deployments by probing new model variants under staged traffic with adaptive probing frequency and metric-driven rollback thresholds. This reduces false positives from transient noise and allows faster, safer rollouts for high-traffic customers.

What this PR does:
- Introduces a "dynamic probing" controller that adjusts probe sampling rate based on recent metric variance and traffic volume.
- Adds a new probe stage for shadow traffic that can run targeted probes against production traffic patterns without affecting user latency.
- Extends the autorollback policy to support multi-metric aggregation (latency p95, error rate, and quality regression score) and configurable hysteresis windows.
- Adds stability guards to prevent rollback during transient upstream incidents (e.g., region-level capacity events).
- Backwards compatible: existing rollout specs will continue to work; new behavior opt-in via rollout.strategy.probing.dynamic: true.

Checklist:

- [x] integration tests for staged shadow probing
- [x] e2e simulation against synthetic traffic patterns
- [x] observability: dashboards and alert rules
- [x] update docs and examples
